items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening created to reach the leaking pipe is a repair cost under 7.1.7(a). The work is confined to the affected wall area, so it is indemnified at a moderate trade price.
This is the first travel charge on the contractor's invoice, so 7.1.7(f) allows it. Valued at the price prior of about 81.
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c), at a small amount.
Replacement pipe section for the failed cold water line is part of the necessary repair under 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(c).
Insulation that formed part of the installed pipe is covered under 7.1.7(c).
Trade labour for the repair is covered under 7.1.7(g), at a customary hourly rate.
The contractor's own diagnostic and measuring devices are excluded by 7.1.8(b).
Labour for opening the wall and repairing the pipe is covered under 7.1.7(g). Valued at the price prior of about 47/hr x 9 hrs.
7.1.7(f) indemnifies only the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, so this second charge falls away.
Drying before repair and the equipment deployment are covered once under 7.1.7(b) and (e). Priced in line with the reference cases.
Blades are reusable contractor equipment, excluded by 7.1.8(b).
Pipe fittings needed to connect the repaired section are covered under 7.1.7(c).
This repeats item 4 for the same single repair. 7.1.8(c) and (d) pay only the first charge.
This duplicates the insulation already charged in item 5 for the same 1 m section. Under 7.1.8(c) and (d) it is likely excluded.

An identical second 9-hour block for a small repair looks like a duplicate charge under 7.1.8(c) and exceeds the reasonable time allowed by 7.1.7(g). If accepted, it would be valued at the prior rate.
